verses.en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
verses.pt: Com minha voz clamo ao SENHOR; com minha voz suplico ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
verses.en_bbe: <Maschil. Of David. A prayer when he was in the hole of the rock.> The sound of my cry went up to the Lord; with my voice I made my prayer for grace to the Lord.

verses.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.pt: Diante dele derramo meu pedido; diante dele contei minha angústia.
verses.en_web: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.
verses.en_bbe: I put all my sorrows before him; and made clear to him all my trouble.

verses.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.pt: Estando meu espírito angustiado em mim, tu conheceste meu percurso; no caminho em que eu andava esconderam um laço de armadilha para mim.
verses.en_web: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.en_bbe: When my spirit is overcome, your eyes are on my goings; nets have been secretly placed in the way in which I go.

verses.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.pt: Eu olho à direita, e eis que não há quem me conheça; não há nenhum refúgio para mim; nem ninguém se importava com minha alma.
verses.en_web: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Looking to my right side, I saw no man who was my friend: I had no safe place; no one had any care for my soul.

verses.en: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.pt: Eu clamo a ti, SENHOR, dizendo: Tu és meu refúgio, e minha porção na terra dos viventes.
verses.en_web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
verses.en_bbe: I have made my cry to you, O Lord; I have said, You are my safe place, and my heritage in the land of the living.

verses.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.pt: Presta atenção aos meus gritos, porque estou muito oprimido; resgata-me daqueles que me perseguem, pois são mais fortes que eu.
verses.en_web: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than me.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to my cry, for I am made very low: take me out of the hands of my haters, for they are stronger than I.

verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.pt: Tira minha alma da prisão, para que eu louve o teu nome; os justos me rodearão, porque tu me tratarás bem. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.
verses.en_bbe: Take my soul out of prison, so that I may give praise to your name: the upright will give praise because of me; for you have given me a full reward.
